chunks: 34 - Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ali narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from a man, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:
You will continue to expect (deliverance) and it will continue until Allah sends for this matter one whom you do not know whether he is created or not created.

key_terms.أَمْ لَمْ يُخْلَقْ: Or not created (referring to the concealment of his birth)
key_terms.لِهَذَا الْأَمْرِ: For this matter (referring to the Imamate/Leadership)

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by 'whom you do not know whether he is created or not'?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Baqir highlights the perpetual state of *intizar* (expectation) among believers until the emergence of the Mahdi, whose creation was so concealed that people were uncertain if he had been born yet. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the 'Greater Occultation' (al-Ghayba al-Kubra), where the Imam's existence remains hidden from public view to preserve him from enemies, fulfilling the divine promise of inheritance upon the earth.
